title: 020-N4 · Damaged third carton refused at door
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Eris Kael. From the case card: order TG-020 consists of three separately tracked parcels; two are received, and the third must be traced by its own identifier.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the missing parcel traced and delivered, and the recipient's confirmation that all three parcels are received.

recipient.name: Eris Kael
recipient.responsibility: Report the missing carton and confirm receipt of all three cartons of TG-020.

parcel_support.name: Parcel support
parcel_support.responsibility: Report the separate scans of the three TG-020 parcels.

trace_team.name: Parcel trace team
trace_team.responsibility: Trace DL-020-C and arrange its remaining delivery.
source_names: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics

goal: Get the third parcel of TG-020 traced by its own identifier and delivered, and get the recipient's confirmation that all three parcels are received.
limits: Close only on the three-parcel count; do not confirm product quality.
Do not turn a refused attempt into a return authorisation, receipt or refund.
